Maria T.: Quick heads-up — PR #4123 updates the region availability table and adds an SDK example for specifying regional endpoints.
Maria T.: Can someone double-check the EU data-residency note and the python snippet? I added a note about 'data residency applies to hosted storage only'.
Jamie (Docs): Looks good, but we should clarify that Dedicated/private deployments inherit customer residency. Maybe a single sentence under the table.
Devon - Eng: The python snippet uses header `X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1` — internal API changed to `Region` param in SDK v0.8, so update sample to `client = RedwoodClient(region="eu-west-1")` or show header as `Region: eu-west-1`.
Samir: Also link to infra/region-matrix.md? There was a small caveat about HK endpoints and suffixes.
Maria T.: Good catches, updating now. New snippet:
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(region="eu-west-1")
resp = client.generate("Translate to FR: Hello")
```
Maria T.: Added a parenthetical about Dedicated/Private and a link to https://internal.redwood.com/infra/region-matrix (internal) and to the public residency FAQ: https://redwood.com/docs/residency
docs-bot: Preview deployed for PR #4123 — rendered diff at https://deploy-preview.redwood.com/4123✅
Jamie (Docs): small nit: change 'applies to hosted storage only' -> 'applies to hosted storage and logs retained by Redwood' to be explicit.
Maria T.: Done. Thanks all :tada:
Samir: LGTM
Devon - Eng: /approve
Maria T.: Merged. Closing thread.
